 THIS PETITION COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE E.S.INDIRESH  ORAL ORDER

In this writ petition, the petitioners are assailing the Award Notice dated 17th December, 2020 issued by the NC: 2024:KHC:45664 WP NO.11465 OF 2023 respondent No.2-Special Land Acquisition Officer in respect of the subject land belongs to petitioners; inter alia sought for direction to the respondent-Authorities to pay compensation fixed by consent under Section 29 of the Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Act, (For short, hereinafter referred to as 'KIAD Act').

2. Heard Sri. Kaleemullah Shariff, learned counsel appearing for petitioners; Sri. Manjunath K.,
learned High Court Government Pleader appearing for the respondent No.1 and Sri. C.
Channegowda, learned counsel appearing for respondent No.2 .
3. Having Heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties, on perusal of the writ petition, the same would indicate that the petitioners claim to be owners of the subject land and the said land has Smt. Lakshminarayanamma vs The State Of Karnataka on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/48488169/
2 been acquired by the respondent No.2 for the purpose of industrial development.

sentences.text: 4. The Co-ordinate Bench of this Court, in an identical matter of similar nature in Writ Petition No.13463 of 2022 decided on 15th July, 2022, allowed the writ petition and direction has been issued to the respondent-Karnataka NC: 2024:KHC:45664 WP NO.11465 OF 2023 Industrial Area Development Board to consider the case of the petitioners therein under Section 29(2) of the KIAD Act.

entities.text: WP NO.11465 OF 2023 Industrial Area Development Board
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: In that view of the matter, I am of the considered opinion that the present petition also deserves to be allowed on the same terms, as the petitioners herein are seeking for the identical relief.
